title: Push Notification System
vague_prompt: Design a push notification system that sends millions of messages.
hidden_guidance: 200 million notifications per day, with a peak of 20 thousand per second
Channels are mobile push through APNs and FCM, email, and SMS
Delivery to the provider must start within 5 seconds of the event at p95
Each user has per channel and per category preferences plus quiet hours
A failed send retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff, then goes to a dead letter queue
The same event must not notify one user twice inside a 24 hour window
known_patterns: Event intake queue in front of the fanout service
Fanout service that checks user preferences before it sends
One queue per channel with a provider adapter for each
Retry with exponential backoff and a dead letter queue
Dedup by event id and user id
Delivery tracking and provider rate limits
common_misses: Quiet hours computed in the user timezone
Provider rate limits and expired device tokens
Backpressure when one provider is slow
Bounce and unsubscribe handling for email
